name: hallmark
description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
one_liner: A rulebook that stops AI website builders from producing the same generic-looking template everyone gets, by picking from fifty distinct visual styles and checking the result against a list of telltale 'AI-made' signs.
buyer: A solo SaaS founder or indie hacker building their own product site who wants it to look custom-designed without hiring or paying a designer.
business_use_cases: An indie founder uses it to generate a launch landing page that doesn't scream 'built with AI' to potential customers or investors.
A small agency standardizes client site builds on it so output quality doesn't depend on which staff member or AI tool did the work.
A freelance developer offers a 'redesign audit' service, using the skill's audit mode to show prospective clients concrete problems with their current site.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a flat-fee 'de-slop my AI-built site' audit and fix service to founders who already built a site with AI tools.
Sell a curated set of client-ready theme presets built on top of it for a specific niche (e.g. fintech, local services).

steal_this: Run `/hallmark audit` against three AI-generated sites you can find publicly, then cold-pitch those businesses a fixed-price redesign using the findings as proof.
